proposedScene.pcStyle: original unbranded gaming ATX mid-tower with removable glass front and side

camera.view: slightly elevated three-quarter side and front
camera.framing: keep the entire exploded assembly inside the frame

lighting.fill: gentle fill for readable internal components
lighting.rim: narrow neutral light to define black metal edges
lighting.componentLEDs: constant restrained ice-blue fan rings, case edges, RAM spines and GPU side lightbar

keyPoses.state: exploded assembly with clear readable gaps
fully assembled; transforms exactly match the first pose

movementRules: Open the glass panel before moving internal components.
Disconnect cables and remove mounted components before extracting the motherboard.
Keep CPU/DIMM/M.2 sockets and motherboard mounting structures with the motherboard.
Move each component along a path consistent with its mounting direction.
Use intermediate keyframes to prevent components passing through one another.
Keep cable and connector movement deterministic for reverse scrolling.
Keep the camera, materials and lighting consistent across all frames.

productionMilestones: Inspect the chosen model's objects, materials, dependencies and usage terms.
Produce one assembled still and one exploded still from the same actual 3D scene.
Review composition, internal visibility and part separation before the full animation render.
Render the animation master and optimize desktop and mobile outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: The same mesh geometry and material setup are used for every frame.
No visible intersection, flicker or unexplained appearance/disappearance of parts.
Forward and reverse playback show the same pose at the same progress.
Both assembled end poses match exactly.
Deliver an editable .blend scene with camera, lights, materials, animation and required dependencies.
Deliver a lossless numbered frame master, website-optimized outputs and a poster.
